name: beautiful-embedded-c
description: Write, review, port, and enforce deterministic, safety-critical Embedded C (C11) across all firmware layers (app, bsp, config, drv, libs, ISRs, RTOS tasks, and host tests): a writing skill, a review skill, and a cross-MCU porting skill, distilled from Jacob Beningo's Reusable Firmware Development, James Grenning's Test-Driven Development for Embedded C, NASA JPL's Power of 10, BARR-C:2018, the MISRA C Essential Type Model, and RTOS & ISR framework conventions (six authoritative reference digests), plus drop-in lints, dual-target CMake and Make build configs, and multi-layer scaffolding.
